name: base_damage
description: Base damage of one hit for one damage class: damage formulas 1-0x17, the variance factor ((draw & 31) + 240, or 256), Armor/Mental Break zeroing the defences of an HP command, the heal sign. (merged: random inputs over all formulas plus dense DEF/MDF grids and the 32-bit wrap region)

function.signature: int base_damage(Chr *user, Chr *target, Cmd *cmd, int formula, int power, ushort snapshot, int mode, int variance, uint *defOut, uint *mdfOut, int fallback)

rngHook.note: pp_BtlRng(stream). The stream-index helper 0x78d210 is hooked to return 0x14 + user id (+0x10 / +0x20 per mode).

reducedFrom.note: stratified subset; the full set is regenerated by the spec named in the header
